name: desktop-shortcuts
description: Rebuild Desktop\MAST on the Public (all-users) desktop from scratch: MAST Unit Operation (FastAPI contract page, site weather, DS9, logs, PWI4, ASICap, NoMachine, Chrome), Setup and Calibration (instrument calibration, proxy tool, XILab, ASIMount, ASCOM Diagnostics), Development (the mast-clone VS Code workspace, VS Code, Jupyter, Compass, C:\MAST) and Vendor for strays. Web shortcuts launch Chrome directly because the unit resolves http to IE. Third-party tools are created from the resolved exe, not inherited from the sweep. Account-agnostic so they appear for the autologin 'mast' account.
